# DeepSeek Harness — Live Agent-Preset Switch (community fork)

This repository is a **soft fork** of DeepSeek Harness
(`dsh`) that adds one feature: **switching ag
ent presets mid-conversation at turn boundaries**.
All changes live on the `live-agent-preset-switch` branch as a single commit:
- `3b42369` — "Live agent-preset switching at turn boundaries" (80 files, +1604 / -148 vs upstream `
69` — "Live agent-preset switching at turn boundaries" (80 files, +1604 / -148 vs upstream `master`)
Upstream documentation, including the 中文 README, remains untouched on the `master` branch.
## What the feature does

Upstream locks an agent preset (a session's "mode": Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator) at session
crea
tion. Switching modes used to mean abandoning the conversation.
This fork adds a **preset chip in the composer (input bar)**:

- The chip shows the session's current preset (e.g. `Agent preset, current: Standard mode`).
- Click

it to switch to any preset for the *same, already-started* conversation.
- The switch takes effect

at the **next turn boundary**. While a turn is running the chip is
disabled (API callers receive `ag

ent-busy` / `turn-running` and should retry once the agent is
idle), so every turn runs entirely und

er one preset.
- The new-session screen keeps its original chip, which still stages the preset of th

The new-session screen keeps its original chip, which still stages the preset of the *next*
session.
## How it works

- **History projection** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`): when the new preset omits a tool that an
earl

ier turn used, that tool call/result is degraded to deterministic, truncated text instead
of being d

ropped, so the conversation stays legible; adapter-private replay state is discarded
so replay-aware

providers never fail per-block validation (`INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`).
- **Model-visible ⟺ logged**: t

he session log remains the single source of truth. A switch is
recorded as an `agent-preset/selected

` event, and every request projection is a pure function
of the log, so cold replays and exports rep

roduce exactly.
- **Turn-boundary guard** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy`): `agentPreset.select` k

eeps the
blank-session fast path and additionally allows a started conversation while the agent is
i
dle. `agent-preset-locked` is no longer produced (kept only for wire compatibility).
Full design rationale: `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-14-live-agent-preset-switch.md`.
## Get it

Open `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, start a conversation, and use the chip in the composer.

> The fork feature is available from a source checkout only. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` installs the
> u
pstream npm package, which does not include it.
## Presets
| Preset     | Mode              |

| `standard` | Standard mode (default) |
| `code`     | PTC mode          |
| `minimal`  | Minimal m

ode      |
| `cordis`   | Creator mode      |

You can switch back and forth inside one conversation (e.g. Standard → Minimal → Standard); each
tur
n runs under the preset that was current when it started.
## What changed vs upstream

- **Core**: `packages/core/session` (tool-call degradation during history derivation),
`packages/cor

e/agent-loop` (history derived per assembled tool catalog),
`packages/host/apiproxy` (turn-boundary

guard), plus holder-contract docs in
`packages/core/scope` and `packages/preset/agent-presets`.
- **

Client**: `packages/client/ui-agent-preset` (composer chip + store) and the
`conversation.input.agen

tPreset` seat in `packages/client/ui-conversation`.
- **Tests**: session degradation suite, preset l

ive-switch suite, apiproxy suite, composer-store
client tests, and web e2e (9 cases, including a liv

e composer switch). Verified in a real
session (Standard → Minimal → Standard) and across the six to
uched package test suites.

`PR-PRESET-SWITCH.md` is the complete delivery list, including what a
full Linux CI run should doubl

ET-SWITCH.md` is the complete delivery list, including what a
full Linux CI run should double-check.
## Why a fork

Upstream does not accept external pull requests at the moment (see its `CONTRIBUTING.md`), so this
s

hips as a community soft fork. If upstream opens to PRs later, `PR-PRESET-SWITCH.md` documents
what
a review would need.
